Hey Joseph,

Because it eliminates awkward partially expiring tickets, one final-final mechanics adjustment should make everything cleaner and easier to code.

This rule should replace the earlier description of ticket lifespans:
→ Whenever someone mints using a referral code, the referrer’s NFT immediately receives both of these separate ticket allocations:
+3 Small Block Tickets
+3 Big Block Tickets

The two counters operate completely independently.

For the Small Block ($9K pool → 3 × $3K draw):
Only Small Block Tickets issued after the previous small block can enter the draw.
Once the draw is complete, burn every Small Block Ticket and reset the counter to -2.

For the Big Block ($72K pool → 8 × $9K draw):
Eligibility is limited to Big Block Tickets issued after the previous big block.
Once that draw is complete, burn every Big Block Ticket and reset the counter to -2.

The result is:
Because old tickets never carry forward, small blocks remain very fair and fresh.
Big block entries accumulate naturally, letting people watch their totals rise over weeks or months.
Metadata stays simple because it only needs to display the two counters and permanent badges.

Pool values still control the triggers: the small block fires as soon as its pool reaches exactly $9K, while the big block fires when its pool reaches exactly $72K. Secondary royalties continue filling the pools, but they do not generate tickets.
No other behavior changes, including the automatic $8 commission, assigning a random ticket to an existing NFT when no referral is used, manual claiming, and everything else.
This version should be simpler both to implement and to explain to users.

One issue stands out: Crypto Gateway A is a cryptocurrency payment gateway rather than a genuine fiat/credit-card processor. It does NOT eliminate the need for crypto; users must still have cryptocurrency to pay!

Here is how the current flow works, followed by practical alternatives.
To complete a payment through Crypto Gateway A, users must:
1. Already hold cryptocurrency such as USDC, ETH, or BTC
2. Transfer it from their wallet to finish the payment
3. Pay without direct credit-card acceptance, because the gateway does NOT process cards itself
Consequently, the service is unsuitable for non-crypto users who do not own any cryptocurrency.

Actual Fiat On-Ramp Solutions
A different service is required to accept TRUE credit-card payments through Card Network A or Card Network B:

Option 1: Card Processor A + Crypto (Recommended)
Best for: Automatic blockchain transactions funded directly by card
Pros:
- Users never need to hold crypto
- Credit cards are genuinely accepted
- The checkout experience is familiar
- Fees are lower than for crypto payments

Cons:
- Account verification by Card Processor A is required
- Each transaction costs 3.4% + $0.45

Option 2: On-Ramp Platform B (Different from Crypto Gateway A)
On-Ramp Platform B supports:
- Converting fiat → crypto
- Payments by credit card
- Authentication through OAuth

Pros:
- Fiat → crypto functionality is integrated
- It benefits from the trusted brand of Digital Asset Platform C

Cons:
- Users must first purchase crypto
- An account with Digital Asset Platform C is required

Option 3: Third-Party Fiat Gateways
The following services provide genuine fiat → crypto functionality:
- Widget Provider A - Credit card → crypto widget
- On-Ramp Provider B - Fiat on-ramp widget
- Gateway Provider C - Fiat gateway (being sunset)
- On-Ramp Provider D - Global fiat on-ramp

Pros:
- Pre-built widgets are available
- Credit-card payments are genuinely supported
- Coverage is global

Cons:
- KYC requirements apply
- Users still see the crypto conversion
- Fees are higher (4-7%)

Page Title: About Project Rebuild
Sub-title: The first ebook launch to reward readers for spreading the word.

What is Project Rebuild?
Serving as the live proof-of-concept for FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model), Project Rebuild demonstrates the first system that lets indie creators sell NFT ebooks with unlimited mints while rewarding readers with real commissions and prize tickets for sharing them.
The launch will take place on Base with my own raw memoir novella, "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal."
Project Rebuild also represents my public mission to rebuild my family's life after I lost millions in a seed-phrase wipeout.

If our FAMM succeeds in this trial, Project Rebuild will evolve into BooksOnChain, a community-owned public-good platform available to every creator.

Cutting-Edge Technology Behind It

- Smart Contracts
Audited, secure Solidity contracts run on Base.
- Chainlink VRF
Prize-draw winners are chosen using provably fair randomness.
- Aave Integration
Deposited prize-pool funds generate yield.
- Base Network
Transactions remain fast and inexpensive while benefiting from Ethereum security.
- Decentralized
From day one, all logic is on-chain, although V1 begins with safeguards.
(After battle-testing, it will progress toward full decentralization.)

- Secure
Security comes from industry-leading protocols and best practices.

How It Works

Mint Your ebook NFT
Purchase your ebook NFT for $24 USD, and use the resulting mint number as your referral code.

Earn Through Referrals
By sharing your mint number or link, you instantly receive $8 USD whenever someone uses it to mint. There are no limits or expiration dates.
When a mint uses no code, its $8 and tickets are awarded to a randomly chosen existing ticket holder.

Accumulate Tickets
For the active blocks, each referral adds both Small and Big Block prize tickets to your total.
As your referrals increase, so do your ticket count and chances of winning.

Win Prizes
Every 1,800 sales triggers 9 Small Block prizes of $840 each.
Every 108,000 sales triggers 9 Big Block prizes of $24,000 each.
(A sale can be either a mint or a secondary transaction.)
Chainlink VRF selects winners randomly and fairly.

Claim Your Rewards
Smart contracts send commissions automatically on-chain. Prize announcements appear on the Winners page, where you can claim with one click whenever you're ready.

Key Features

Automatic Rewards: Payments are immediate and handled entirely by smart contracts.
Fair Prize Selection: True randomness is provided by Chainlink VRF.
Yield Generation: Through Aave integration, the prize pools earn yield.
Gamification: Badges and leaderboards keep the experience fun and competitive.
Transparency: Every rule and transaction is on-chain and verifiable.
Low Fees: Base keeps the system fast while minimizing transaction costs.

Our Vision
Although Project Rebuild begins with a single book, it is only the starting point.
We envision ebooks succeeding purely on merit, without gatekeepers or Amazon algorithms drowning out indie voices.
Unknown and established creators alike should rise because their work resonates—not because they manipulate a platform, know the right people, or purchase enough ads.
Fans should be compensated for the word-of-mouth promotion they have always provided for free, while any hustler who discovers a gem worth sharing can jump in and earn.

Our goal is to build a self-sustaining model that works for everyone.
Artists receive their fair share, fans and affiliates develop real income, and communities form direct bonds—turning one underdog's recovery into a decentralized revolution for every creator.
It relies on aligned incentives rather than hype.

Page Title: Our Mission
Sub-title: Creating a community-driven platform where creators and fans can succeed together—beginning with my rebuild.

Our Purpose
Rather than being only an ebook launch, Project Rebuild is a movement aimed at repairing what publishing gets wrong.
A FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model) is what I built after losing millions to a seed-phrase wipeout, allowing creators to sell directly while fans receive instant, unlimited commissions and prizes for spreading their work.
Our mission is to establish a fair, transparent ecosystem that rewards creators and fans for their contributions, referrals, and participation, without gatekeepers or artificial hype.

Community First

Collective growth accelerates whenever an individual member succeeds, turning each personal win into shared momentum. That is the power of community we believe in.

Fair Rewards
Everyone receives what they deserve through transparent, unlimited rewards delivered on-chain. Middlemen and hidden terms have no place in the process.

Innovation
By proving our FAMM first, we're pushing the boundaries of NFT, smart contracts, and decentralized technology, with a full DAO as the goal once sufficient momentum develops.

Long-Term Vision
Sustainability and genuine impact guide what we're building for the long term. Lasting value will scale from one underdog story into a platform that serves everyone.

What We're Building
Referral Rewards: Receive $8 for every person you successfully refer to the project. Expanding the network also increases your rewards.
Prize Pools: Through Chainlink VRF randomness, referrers receive a fair chance at major wins. Small Block awards 9 prizes of $840 every 1,800 sales, while Big Block awards 9 prizes of $24,000 every 108,000 sales.
Gamification: Active community members are recognized and rewarded through badges, leaderboards, and achievements that make participation engaging and fun.
Transparency: Everything takes place on-chain, with smart contracts providing fair play and automatic payouts.

Join the Movement
Join a community where your contributions are valued and your success is rewarded.
